description: An old railway platform at night. A young man in a camel coat lifts a young woman in a red coat and black boots off the ground as she throws her arms around him, then sets her down and they hug, smiling with their foreheads touching. A steam train with maroon carriages stands beside them in clouds of steam. At their feet lie a dropped leather suitcase with clothes spilling out and a knocked-over metal bucket of flowers. An old man in a suit and smiling travellers watch under the lamps and the platform clock.
